newsitem.title: JORDAN: Global funds buy $14 million Jordan stock in May.
newsitem.headline: Global funds buy $14 million Jordan stock in May.

text.p: Global fund buying of Jordanian blue-chip stocks last month amounted to 10.1 million dinars ($14.2 million), exceeding the whole of last year's purchases, official bourse statistics showed on Sunday.
Last year, total global fund buying did not exceed 9.6 million dinars ($13.5 million).

The value of non-Jordanian (both global and Arab) purchases of Jordanian blue-chips from the start of 1997 until the end of May topped 24 million dinars in heightened interest in the Amman Financial Market, rated as among the cheapest in the region.
Non-Jordanian purchases, both global and Arab, topped 11.6 million dinars last May from a total 28 million dinars turnover.
But global fund buying dominated with only 1.5 million dinars ($2.1 million) purchased by non-Jordanian Arab investors that month.
Of the total international demand, 82 percent was executed in the second half of May after a roadshow in London focused on available investment opportunities on key Jordanian blue-chips.
Global funds' stake on the bourse stood at end of 1996 at just 1.5 percent of a total market capitalisation of 3.5 billion dinars against 33 percent held by non-Jordanian Arab investors.
The rest is held by the government and Jordanian investors.
